context: Saito treats Mrs. Mori for general wellness; quiet medical visit.
purpose: Doctor caring for elderly community member.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 先生、受診、お願いします。
lines.en: Doctor, I'd like to schedule an appointment, please.
lines.style: Warm, respectful. Careful enunciation on the formal request. Gentle opening — the tone of someone who has lived long enough to know good manners matter. Slight lift at the end, hopeful.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: おはようございます、症状、教えてください。
lines.en: Good morning. Can you tell me what symptoms brought you in today?
lines.style: Professional but genuine. Clear and unhurried — the steady confidence of someone who has had this conversation a hundred times. Warm attention underneath the protocol.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: ふだん、丁寧に過ごしてるんだけど。
lines.en: Well, I usually try to take care of myself, but…
lines.style: Hesitant, self-aware. Acknowledging her own effort before admitting she needed help. Slight trailing-off — not quite apologetic, but checking whether she's being unreasonable.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Your recovery is looking very smooth, I'm pleased to say.
lines.style: Warm reassurance. Definite, settled tone on the good news. Speaking as someone who genuinely sees the improvement and is genuinely relieved.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 熱心に治療してくれて、感謝。
lines.en: Thank you for treating me so carefully and thoughtfully.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, not performed. Eyes soft. The particular warmth of someone recognizing that her care was personal, not perfunctory. Quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 優しい言葉、こちらこそ。
lines.en: Your kindness means a lot to me too.
lines.style: Modest deflection wrapped in real warmth. A small, honest moment between two people who respect each other. Not effusive, but genuine.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: I'll be back to see you again soon.
lines.style: Warm, assured. A gentle promise — the comfortable tone of someone establishing a continuation. Not anxious, simply planning to return.
